pre_event_materials: Vite official React + TypeScript app template (index.html, Vite config, npm run dev). Not a prebuilt P10 solution.

sample_data.method: Household tab: click Load 6-month household for src/data/household.json (same schema as the published pack). Judges may also paste a published case into the textarea and click Load pasted JSON.
sample_data.reset_instructions: Refresh the browser, or click Load 6-month household again. Nothing is stored on a server. There is no login and no database.

problem_solving_method: All taka math lives in one browser engine (src/billingEngine.ts). The UI only displays engine results. The four required P10 items are four tabs in problem order. Dates stay YYYY-MM-DD strings so the 1st of the month does not shift in UTC. Habit cost is energy + VAT + ৳82, never the deposit (R-33). Both habits use the same daily units (R-16). A fifth tab, Plan, is a bonus: slab headroom this month and a Friday–Saturday shop-closure recharge so the family does not go dark when shops are closed.

R1.evidence: Household tab. Button Load 6-month household → src/data/household.json (HH-DHAKA-01, Jan–Jun 2026, light January, heavy May, ৳5000 on 2026-06-28). src/App.tsx summarizeHousehold.

R2.evidence: Balance tab. Recharts day-by-day line with green recharge marks. Engine: src/billingEngine.ts runSimulation (slabs, ৳82 on first recharge of the calendar month, 5% VAT on energy only).

R3.evidence: Questions tab. Run-out date at usual daily use; date picker for amount to recharge today, split into energy, higher slab, fixed charges, VAT. src/billingEngine.ts runPredictions.

R4.evidence: Habits tab. Same comparison.months and same units. Low balance vs 1st of month. Cost is energy+VAT+৳82, not deposits. Ties allowed. src/billingEngine.ts compareHabits.

R5.evidence: Bonus Plan tab (not one of the four scored items). Slab headroom + Friday–Saturday shop-closure advice + Download family plan. src/billingEngine.ts getSlabPosition / adviseClosedShopRecharge; src/familyPlan.ts; src/App.tsx Plan section.

team_members.major_contribution: Product: four required tabs, household JSON, billing engine (slabs, simulation, predictions, habits), stay-on Plan bonus, engine tests, README / licenses / architecture / evaluation-manifest, live deploy.

major_design_decisions: Browser-only engine so the live URL needs no server.
Four required tabs in problem order, plus a clearly labelled Plan bonus tab.
Habit cost is billed energy + VAT + ৳82, never the deposit amount (R-33).
String dates and two-decimal taka so the 1st of the month and paisa stay stable.
npm test runs every public case and prints PASS/FAIL plus a summary in the terminal.
known_limitations: Rates are the problem pack table, not a live circular lookup.
A { "cases": [...] } paste uses the first case only.
Refreshing the page clears the loaded household (no login, no database).
Higher-slab line is energy minus (units × 4.63), not a separate billed fee.
Demo video URL is empty until the recording is uploaded.
Family plan download is a local text file; it is not emailed or stored remotely.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Drafting TypeScript UI, billing-engine helpers, tests, architecture, README, and this manifest.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Official tariff constants were copied from the problem pack and must not change. Behaviour was checked with npm test (unit checks plus all public cases), tsc, oxlint, and vite build. R-16 and R-33 are asserted in test-runner.js.

declaration: The information above is complete and truthful to the best of the team's knowledge.
